strategy.summary: Account US: US$1,000, US-listed stocks only, in USD. PAPER ONLY.
rules: Universe: /workspace/ai-value-chain-2026-10.md plus the US names in the shortlist (V, MSFT, GOOGL, META, ADBE, UNH, ORCL, SAP ADR).

Entries: full size only when score ≥70 and price is at or below the buy price. A starter tranche (≤25%) is allowed when score ≥70, price is within 10% of the buy price, and the stock dipped (below its 50- or 200-day average). No buys after a +10% week.
Post-earnings drift: after a report, add on a beat that the stock holds for 2 days; skip or exit on a miss that gaps the stock down.
Earnings sizing: max 20% in any name reporting within the window, with no adds in the 2 days before the report. Window dates: META Oct 21, V Oct 27, MSFT/GOOGL/NOW/VRT/EQIX Oct 28, AMZN Oct 29.
Benchmark: VOO (SPY for reference).

Hold 2-15 trading days (max 15, see Hold fix Oct 15; holds may run past the Oct 29 test end and are marked to market then). Setups, in order: (1) pullback in an uptrend: price above the 50-day, 3-5% off the 20-day high, RSI(2) < 10 or 2+ red days, then the first green day; (2) post-earnings drift: beat + raise with a gap that holds day 1, enter day 2-3; (3) existing playbook buy price hit.

Stop: entry − 2×ATR(14), checked on the close (intraday wicks don't count, except a gap below the stop = exit at the open). Target: +3×ATR, sell half there and trail the rest at 2×ATR below the highest close. Time stop: 7 trading days with < +1 ATR progress = exit.
Sizing: risk 1% of equity per trade (US$10 / C$10) ÷ (2×ATR) = shares, capped by existing position limits. Existing positions bought before this rule get ATR stops assigned retroactively.

Daily process (after the 2 PM MT close, ~2:41 PM card): mark positions, check stops/targets/time stops on the close, scan for setups, write a pick in daily-picks.md, execute at the next open + 0.1% slippage.
VETO: negative free cash flow AND rising share count (dilution).
VETO: one customer > 40% of revenue.
VETO: up > 150% in 6 months unless there is a new catalyst (fresh beat-and-raise, contract, guidance).

strategy.summary: GLB branch — Green Line Breakout (Eric Wish), paper only, US$1,000
rules: Monthly chart, split-adjusted. Line = highest monthly HIGH ever (ATH bar).
Valid only after >=3 full monthly bars have closed without exceeding it. If the ATH bar is <3 months old: NO line (stock is extended, not based) -> skip.
Score line age: 3–5 mo = 1 pt, 6–11 mo = 2 pts, 12+ mo = 3 pts (longer clean base = stronger). Wish: base usually < ~1 year; IPOs may use a few weeks (we do NOT use the IPO exception).
Wish: buy on a close above the line, prefers above-avg weekly volume; sells on a daily close back below.
Ours: daily close above line AND (a) holds above line on closes for 3 sessions, OR (b) monthly bar closes above line.
Breakout-day volume >= 1.4x 50-day avg (or breakout week >= 1.4x 10-week avg).
No chase: entry no more than 5% above the line.
Relative strength: 6-month return vs SPY in top 20% of our universe (Wish uses IBD/MarketSmith RS; we proxy).
Trend: price > 50d > 150d > 200d (Minervini) and Wish RWB-style: weekly close above 10-wk avg, 10-wk > 30-wk.
Growth: latest quarter EPS up >=20% y/y AND sales growth >0 (Wish's Darvas scan: EPS >20%, revenue up). Forward EPS per lottery red-team.
Earnings: no entry within 5 trading days of a report (Wish: "no imminent earnings").
All lottery-screen.md vetoes apply.

strategy.summary: **PAUSED Oct 15, 2026 by user: no new picks/trades; focus is US-SWING, CA-SWING, GLB. Files kept.**
rules: Pick (one): highest first-bar rvol (≥ 2) where the first 5-min candle is green AND the gap is ≥ +0.5% (gap-and-go, aligned with the gap), preferably with a catalyst. Long only (no shorting in this test). If none qualifies → FLAT. Gap-fades are not used (weaker evidence and they need shorting).
Entry: buy-stop at ORH from bar 2 on; fill = max(bar open, ORH) + 0.1% slippage. Must trigger by 11:00 ET or the day is FLAT.
Stop: ORL (must be ≥ 0.3% below entry, else skip). No moving the stop down, no averaging down.
Target: none by default (Zarattini holds to the close); take half off at +3R; move the stop to breakeven after +1.5R. Stay above VWAP: a 5-min close below VWAP after +1R = exit.

Time exit: flat at 15:55 ET (13:55 MT) at the bar close − 0.1% slippage. Optional: last-half-hour momentum (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2018, "Market intraday momentum"): if SPY's first-30-min return and the position are both up at 15:30 ET, hold to the close; otherwise exit at 15:30 ET.
Sizing: risk 1% of equity (≈ US$10) ÷ (entry − stop) = shares; max 100% of equity, no margin.
Daily loss limit: −2% of equity = stop for the day; −5% from peak = cut risk to 0.5% per trade until a new high.

Use yfinance 5-min bars (only ~60 days of history) plus daily OHLC as a check. Entries/exits are bar-based: if a bar touches both the stop and the target, assume the stop hit first. Slippage 0.1% each way. No fills inside the opening bar. Gaps through the stop fill at the bar open.
If a decision is made late (after 11:00 ET), simulate from the bars exactly as the rules would have triggered, and label it "simulated after the fact" in the ledger.
Top priority: earnings beat-and-raise gaps on >= 2x relative volume with a real catalyst.
Skip story / microcap pumps (SoundHound/IonQ-type moves) unless there is real news; they often reverse intraday.
No thin names: skip anything below US price $5 or avg dollar volume US$20M/day.

strategy.summary: Account LOTTERY-US: US$1,000, US-listed, USD. PAPER ONLY. Oct 15, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027 (3-month horizon).
rules: Only names that qualify (≥7/10 + trend template + trigger). Trigger = (a) breakout close above the base or 52-week high on ≥1.4x volume, or (b) a post-earnings beat-and-raise gap ≥5% on ≥2x volume, entered day 2-3 while it holds the gap-day low.

Cash is a position: no forced buys.
3-5 positions, each 20-33% (start at 20-25%; add up to 33% only after it's +10% and holds the 50-day). Risk per position ≤ 5% of equity (size × stop distance).

Time stop: no progress (< +5%) after 8 weeks = exit and redeploy.

Account metrics: return vs VOO, max drawdown, hit rate (expect 25-40%), avg winner ÷ avg loser (target > 3), "gave back" (% of peak open profit lost).
